explanation: TryCopyConsStringDirect now receives a std::span and derives bounded subspans for both cons-string halves. The changed out-of-line character buffer path is reachable from a dynamic property-key lookup on a 256-character direct cons string.
local_verification: ASan d8 exits 0 with the changed allocation restored to its parent form and reports a heap-buffer-overflow on the edited tree. Rebuilt with gn gen out/x64.asan and ninja -j8 -C out/x64.asan d8.
